title: Understand What's Trending in Lineup Searches
seoTitle: What's Trending in Lineup Searches Explained
subtitle: Players Spark Doubts for Week 2 Matchups
excerpt: Discover which athletes are generating intense searches and creating dilemmas for fantasy managers deciding who to start for Week 2 of the sports season.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The term 'mfl' is among the most searched topics due to uncertainties about who to start and who to bench for Week 2. The results from Week 1 have complicated decisions, leading to questions about standout athletes and team options.

Devaughn Vele Gains Prominence in Searches

Devaughn Vele became one of the most added players after an impressive performance against Detroit, with seven receptions for 69 yards and a touchdown. He played 82 snaps against the Lions, out-snapping other names in the New Orleans wide receiver group. The team will look to keep pace with the Ravens' offense, which could again favor Vele's productivity.

Baker Mayfield and the Expectations Against Cleveland

Baker Mayfield looks to bounce back after a poor performance against the Bengals, where he struggled with yardage and lost three fumbles. He will face a Cleveland defense that allowed Trevor Lawrence to have a high-production game in the previous week. The anticipation surrounding this matchup is drawing significant attention from fans and analysts.

Aaron Jones and Offensive Options

With Jordan Mason sidelined due to a thumb injury, Aaron Jones Sr. steps into the spotlight for what should be a high-volume day. Last week, Jones scored a touchdown and now brings a history of scoring against Chicago, aiming to inspire confidence in fantasy managers.

Marvin Harrison Jr.'s Situation

Marvin Harrison Jr. saw only three targets and recorded one reception in the win against the Chargers, while other teammates were more involved. Although he has a positive track record against Seattle in previous seasons, caution is advised until he demonstrates a consistent string of solid performances.

Information from QB List, CBS Sports.
